root_visual_review.scope: Opening and final decoded 360px QA frames and the full contact sheet were inspected in this task. Text is readable, photos are unobscured, and sampled direct cuts contain no blank gaps. Independent reviewer additionally inspected all three scenes at mobile and full size and checked all450 decoded frames for gaps.

accepted_revision: v2 only; v1 retained as evidence and not recommended for upload
limits: Silent photo montage; no garment-motion demonstration, music or voice.
English current-campaign preparation only, not a localized video for every market.
Accepted generated images retain the source-detail limitations in CREATIVE_ACCEPTANCE.json; no new product crop or resynthesis was introduced by the video.
No Google or YouTube upload, publication, asset association, platform acceptance, Excellent Ad Strength or profit has been verified.
